notes.title: Version 1.3. released
notes.content:
Thanks for the help with testing v1.3!

As of now ChessVR supports the oculus rift as well with a gamepad as well as some achievments!

But there are a few things more as well.

Check it out and let me know what you think!

Changelog:

ADDED: UCI support, comes by default with stockfish but you can replace that (if your prefered engine doesn't seem to work tell me which one and I'll look into it).

ADDED: Challenges, try yourself at some chess puzzles (All of them require you to win in 2 moves)

ADDED: Gamepad support

ADDED: Steam achievements

ADDED: Free movement, if you don't like the default position you can change that now (touchpad on vive controller, wasd eq, right stick/rb/lb on gamepad)

ADDED: Turn indicator, the players base lights up

ADDED: Speed up animation if you don't want to wait for the whole animation (grip button/spacebar/"X" on gamepad)

FIXED: Corrected white/black selection

FIXED: Bishop/Queen animation
